title: Efficient Kernelized Learning in Polyhedral Games Beyond Full-Information: From Colonel Blotto to Congestion Games
abstract: arXiv:2509.20919v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We examine the problem of efficiently learning coarse correlated equilibria (CCE) in polyhedral games, that is, normal-form games with an exponentially large number of actions per player and an underlying combinatorial structure. Prominent examples of such games are the classical Colonel Blotto and congestion games. To achieve computational efficiency, the learning algorithms must exhibit regret and per-iteration complexity that scale polylogarithmically in the size of the players' action sets. This challenge has recently been addressed in the full-information setting, primarily through the use of kernelization. However, in the case of the realistic, but mathematically challenging, partial-information setting, existing approaches result in suboptimal and impractical runtime complexity to learn CCE. translated_title: 多面体博弈中超越完全信息的高效核化学习：从布洛托上校博弈到拥塞博弈
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在多面体博弈中高效学习粗相关均衡（CCE）的问题。多面体博弈是指每个玩家拥有指数级数量动作且具有潜在组合结构的标准型博弈，其典型代表是经典的布洛托上校博弈和拥塞博弈。为实现计算效率，学习算法必须保证遗憾度与单次迭代复杂度随玩家动作集规模呈多对数级增长。这一挑战最近已在完全信息环境下得到解决，主要依靠核化技术。然而，在更贴近现实但数学上更具挑战性的部分信息环境下，现有的粗相关均衡学习方法会导致次优且不切实际的运行时间复杂度。我们通过构建一个基于核化范式的框架来解决这一局限，并将该框架应用于典型的多面体博弈实例……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于核化范式的新框架，首次在部分信息环境下实现了多面体博弈（如布洛托上校博弈和拥塞博弈）中粗相关均衡的高效学习，使遗憾度与单次迭代复杂度随动作集规模呈多对数级增长。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a kernelization-based framework that achieves efficient learning of coarse correlated equilibria in polyhedral games (e.g., Colonel Blotto and congestion games) under the challenging partial-information setting, with regret and per-iteration complexity scaling polylogarithmically in the size of the action sets.
